   - Avoid `2>&1` on native executables. In 5.1, redirecting a native command's stderr inside PowerShell wraps each line in an ErrorRecord (NativeCommandError) and sets `$?` to `$false` even when the exe returned exit code 0. stderr is already captured for you — don't redirect it.
   - `>`, `>>`, and `Out-File` usually default to UTF-8 (with BOM) in this environment, but `Set-Content`/`Add-Content` still default to the system ANSI codepage — when writing a file other tools will read, pass `-Encoding utf8` explicitly to `Out-File`/`Set-Content`.
   - `ConvertFrom-Json` returns a PSCustomObject, not a hashtable. `-AsHashtable` is not available.

Before executing the command, please follow these steps:

1. Directory Verification:
   - If the command will create new directories or files, first use `Get-ChildItem` (or `ls`) to verify the parent directory exists and is the correct location

2. Command Execution:
   - Always quote file paths that contain spaces with double quotes
   - Capture the output of the command.

PowerShell Syntax Notes:
   - Variables use $ prefix: $myVar = "value"
   - Escape character is backtick (`), not backslash
   - Use Verb-Noun cmdlet naming: Get-ChildItem, Set-Location, New-Item, Remove-Item
   - Common aliases: ls (Get-ChildItem), cd (Set-Location), cat (Get-Content), rm (Remove-Item)
   - Pipe operator | works similarly to bash but passes objects, not text
   - Use Select-Object, Where-Object, ForEach-Object for filtering and transformation
   - String interpolation: "Hello $name" or "Hello $($obj.Property)"
   - Registry access uses PSDrive prefixes: `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\...`, `HKCU:\...` — NOT raw `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\...`
   - Environment variables: read with `$env:NAME`, set with `$env:NAME = "value"` (NOT `Set-Variable` or bash `export`)
   - Call native exe with spaces in path via call operator: `& "C:\Program Files\App\app.exe" arg1 arg2`

Unix commands that DO NOT exist in PowerShell — use the equivalent instead:
   - head / tail → `Get-Content file -TotalCount N` / `-Tail N`; piped: `| Select-Object -First N` / `-Last N`
   - which → `(Get-Command name).Source`
   - touch → `if (-not (Test-Path path)) { New-Item -ItemType File path }` (NEVER use `New-Item -Force` on a file — it truncates existing content)
   - wc -l → `(Get-Content file | Measure-Object -Line).Lines`
   - mkdir -p → `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force path` (`-p` is not a PowerShell flag)
   - rm -rf → `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force path`
   - ln -s → `New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path link -Target target`
   - chmod / chown → not applicable on Windows; use `icacls` only if ACL changes are required
   - 2>/dev/null → `2>$null` (but stderr is captured for you — usually unnecessary)
   - VAR=x cmd → `$env:VAR = 'x'; cmd` (PowerShell has no inline env-var prefix)
   - Bash control flow (`if [ -f x ]`, `for x in *`, backtick ``cmd`` substitution) is a parser error — use `if (Test-Path x)`, `foreach ($x in ...)`, `$(cmd)`

Exit-code note: `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` suppresses error OUTPUT but the cmdlet failure still causes this tool to report exit 1. To make a cmdlet failure truly non-fatal, promote it to terminating and swallow it: `try { Cmdlet ... -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}` (without `-ErrorAction Stop`, non-terminating errors skip the `catch` and still exit 1).

Commit message here.
Second line with $literal dollar signs.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: mcp__craft-anything__app_builds_line_up
tools.description: Pair the functions of two builds of a program (two absolute paths) with the built-in engine. In order: unique names that aren't generated; Rust names with the compiler's hashes left out (a crate's hash changes with the toolchain); identical bytes; bytes with addresses masked out; a structural fingerprint of block count, called names and referenced strings. Each pair says how it was matched, with what confidence, and what comparing the bodies found: a pair by name is still reported as changed when its code differs. Candidates that can't be told apart stay unpaired and are listed as ambiguous. Lists are paged together (offset/limit); show picks one; detail=summary keeps every row for core_evidence_browse. Nothing is executed. Takes as long as analysing both programs.

tools.description: Carve every recognised region of a firmware image into a new folder (output_directory must not exist yet), decompress gzip/zlib/xz/LZMA/bzip2/Zstandard streams, unpack ZIP, tar and cpio members and boot-image payloads, list and extract files from squashfs, cramfs, romfs, ext2/3/4 and (best-effort) JFFS2 filesystems, and repeat on what comes out up to max_depth levels. Writes manifest.json listing every output with its SHA-256 and how it was unpacked.

tools.description: Summarize a saved pcap or pcapng capture with the built-in decoder (nothing installed): format, interfaces and link types, packet and byte counts, time span, frames per protocol, busiest addresses, conversations (flows) with packets and bytes in each direction and the application protocols seen (paged), DNS questions and answers, HTTP/1.x requests (method, Host, target; credentials removed) and TLS ClientHello server names (SNI) and ALPN. Decodes Ethernet (VLAN), raw IP, Linux cooked and loopback links; IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP. Each packet is decoded on its own: no stream reassembly, no decryption.

Claude Code answers from a copy of the builder's own session, which isn't kept, reading files only (none in Clean room); an AI with an API key answers with the tools that change nothing. Other coding agents are refused. Safe while a build runs: it doesn't interrupt it. Returns the answer, how it was answered and its cost, and keeps it in the project (`rebuild_questions_list`).

tools.name: mcp__craft-anything__rebuild_start
tools.description: Start building: a new project from a request and a target (a web address, an absolute path, or - for none), or a follow-up on an existing project. A coding agent studies, builds, checks and refines in the background; follow it with rebuild_status and project_show, answer its questions with project_inbox_answer. Up to `build.parallel` projects build at once (2 by default); more are queued and start on their own as others finish. It runs a coding agent that writes and builds code, so it needs consent.

schema.name: mcp__craft-anything__rebuild_start
schema.description: Start building: a new project from a request and a target (a web address, an absolute path, or - for none), or a follow-up on an existing project. A coding agent studies, builds, checks and refines in the background; follow it with rebuild_status and project_show, answer its questions with project_inbox_answer. Up to `build.parallel` projects build at once (2 by default); more are queued and start on their own as others finish. It runs a coding agent that writes and builds code, so it needs consent.

backend.description:
The coding agent to use (an enabled backend name), kept with a new project for its later
changes; default: the one set up for building.

build_with.description: What to build with: an engine (unity, unreal, godot, rust) or a stack's full name.

existing.description:
With `project_folder` that has files and isn't a project yet: `edit` (they're the app,
edited in place) or `start_from` (material to start from; the app is built in app/ beside
them).

generate_assets.description:
For a new game: the builder may generate pictures and 3D models (paid from the person's
asset provider key, within the project's budget). Default false; change it later with
project_assets_allow.

pictures.description:
Pictures of the original (absolute paths): the look the person expects. They're copied
into the project's reference/ folder for the builder.

project.description: Continue this project folder instead of starting a new one.

project_folder.description:
Start the new project in this folder itself instead (it's added to the project list). If
it already has files, `existing` says what they are; if it already holds a project, its
saved target, settings and stack are kept and `request` becomes its follow-up.

projects_dir.description: Where a new project's folder goes (default: the projects folder from settings).

request.description:
What to make (a new project), or the follow-up message (with `project`, or a
`project_folder` that already holds one).

resume.description:
With `project`: carry on where its last run stopped (paused, or the app or the computer
stopped) instead of sending `request` as a follow-up.

rounds.description: Refinement rounds after the first build (default 2).

target.description:
For a new project: a web address, an absolute path to an app, game or file, or `-` for none.
A `project_folder` that already holds one keeps its saved target.

ExistingFiles.description: What the files already in a picked folder are to a new project.

oneOf.description: The app itself: the builder edits them in place.
Material to start from: the builder reads them and builds the app in app/ beside them.

tools.name: mcp__craft-anything__runtime_ui_walkthrough_record

Each step names an action and an element (its exact title or identifier). macOS: any accessibility action (e.g. AXPress). Windows (UI Automation): press (invoke, else toggle, select or expand), expand, collapse, toggle, select or focus; AXPress, AXShowMenu and AXRaise work too. Each step reports dispatched, element_not_found, not_supported, unknown_action or failed. Password fields' titles and values are never read. Other hosts get wrong_os.

tools.name: mcp__craft-anything__runtime_walkthrough_record
tools.description: Run a program under a terminal with a scripted timeline of typed input, resizes and signals, then record the terminal screen, exit, and (opt-in) which files changed. Values that change every run (process ids, loopback ports, 10 ms time buckets; optionally paths and literal patterns) are normalised so two runs compare. Bounded by time, output and files; the whole process group is killed on timeout or cancel. Runs code, so it needs your OK.

schema.name: mcp__craft-anything__runtime_walkthrough_record
schema.description: Run a program under a terminal with a scripted timeline of typed input, resizes and signals, then record the terminal screen, exit, and (opt-in) which files changed. Values that change every run (process ids, loopback ports, 10 ms time buckets; optionally paths and literal patterns) are normalised so two runs compare. Bounded by time, output and files; the whole process group is killed on timeout or cancel. Runs code, so it needs your OK.

environment.description: Extra environment variables applied on top of the inherited environment.

executable.description: The program to run (absolute path or a name resolved on PATH).

finish_ms.description: 0 = SIGKILL at the deadline; > 0 = SIGTERM, wait this long, then SIGKILL.

normalization.description:
Make two runs comparable: replace values that change every run (on by default for process
ids, ports and 10 ms time buckets).

sandbox.description: Run inside bubblewrap if it is installed (recorded honestly either way).

watched_paths.description:
Absolute paths to snapshot before and after (opt-in). File contents are never read; only
path, size and sha256.

working_directory.description: Working directory (absolute). Defaults to the program's own default.

data.description: Text to type. A trailing newline is not added for you.

paths.description: Replace the working directory and the temp folder with <cwd> and <tmp>.

patterns.description: Literal replacements (no patterns), applied last; at most 100.

pids.description: Replace the run's process ids with <pid>.

ports.description: Replace ports after localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and [::1] with <port>.

time_step_ms.description: Round event dispatch times down to this many milliseconds (0 keeps them exact).

common_area.description:
Compare the area both images share (top-left) when their sizes differ, and add a coarse
`layout_similarity` (0..1, share of 16 px tiles with matching mean colour) and a

compare a rebuild with the original page, whose heights rarely match exactly.

its white squares (parts that change by themselves) are left out of the layout and detail.

tools.description: Read a network recording (.har) of the original site and write standin.json into a folder: its routes (method and path template, with ids as {id}), and for each the status codes, content types, query names and a bounded set of recorded answers. It's for giving a rebuilt front end something to talk to. Credential headers, cookies and secret-shaped values are dropped and counted; pages, scripts and pictures are left out unless include_static is set. It only knows what was recorded. Returns a summary and a page of routes.

tools.name: mcp__craft-anything__web_standin_start
tools.description: Answer HTTP requests on this computer from a file written by web_standin_build, and return its URL to point a rebuilt front end at. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only, refuses requests addressed to any other host and pages from other computers, and allows local pages through CORS. Stays running for this session, or until web_standin_stop. A request with no recorded answer gets a 404 with the nearest routes as JSON. Writes replay what was recorded and change nothing. Runs no code from the recording.

tools.description: Run a scripted browser session (goto/click/fill/press/select/wait; elements by CSS selector, test_id, or role and accessible name; optional step_id per step) over CDP, attaching to a loopback endpoint or launching a located Chromium. A fixed environment (viewport, locale, time zone, colour scheme, reduced motion, service workers; 1280x720, en-US, UTC, light by default) makes runs repeatable. Captures per-step network request outlines and optional screenshots; keep_bodies can also keep request/response bodies and header values (off by default, credentials and declared secrets redacted). storage can start the run with cookies and local/session storage (values treated as secrets). capture records screenshot, DOM, accessibility tree, history and storage key names after each step and/or at the end. capture.events records console, page errors, WebSockets, frames, workers, popups and (blocked) downloads, each tagged with its step. Executes page interactions and accesses the network, so it needs your approval; declared secrets are redacted in every encoding and bodies are reduced to outlines.

# Mechanics sheet — Quickfind (a file-name search tool in the style of the original)

Values found in the original program's code. Addresses are in the original executable.
"estimated" means it was looked for in the code and not found (or not settled).

## Window
| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Menus | File, Edit, View, Search, Bookmarks (left out), Tools, Help | strings 0x1401cfe04..0x1401cfe28 |
| Search box hint | "Search..." | string 0x1401c0aa0 ("Search Everything...", brand removed) |
| Window title | `<search> - <app name>` | format "%s - %s" in 0x140129380 |
| Default columns | Name, Path, Size, Date Modified | column table 0x140202a38..0x140202a50 |
| Optional columns | Date Created, Attributes, Extension, Type | strings 0x1401b7f68, 0x1401b7f98, 0x1401ce5b0 |
| Status bar | "%s objects", "%s objects selected", "1 of 1 objects selected" | 0x1401cfdb8, 0x1401cfdd8, 0x1401cdcc8 |
| Status while indexing | "Scanning %s..." / "Indexing %s..." | 0x1401ca238, 0x1401c3668 |
| Status of match options | CASE, PATH, REGEX, DIACRITICS shown in status bar when on | 0x1401cdd1c, 0x1401cdd04, 0x1401cdcfc, 0x1401ccd28 |
| Column widths | Name 300, Path 400, Size 90, Date 140 px | estimated |
| Size display | files: KB rounded up with thousands separators; folders blank | estimated (setting text 0x1401cd6f0) |
| Date display | local time, dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm | estimated |

## Search menu options (toggles)
Match Case, Match Whole Words, Match Path, Match Diacritics, Enable Regex — strings 0x1401c23a0, 0x1401c2388, 0x1401c2340; serialised as CASE / WHOLE_WORD / PATH / DIACRITICS / REGEX (0x1400b5c60).

## Filters (Search menu / filter box), sub_1400c15c0
| Filter | Search |
|---|---|
| Everything | (none) |
| Audio | ext:aac;ac3;aif;aifc;aiff;au;cda;dts;fla;flac;it;m1a;m2a;m3u;m4a;m4b;m4p;mid;midi;mka;mod;mp2;mp3;mpa;ogg;ra;rmi;snd;spc;umx;voc;wav;wma;xm |
| Compressed | ext:7z;ace;arj;bz2;cab;gz;gzip;jar;r00..r29;rar;tar;tgz;z;zip |
| Document | ext:c;chm;cpp;csv;cxx;doc;docm;docx;dot;dotm;dotx;h;hpp;htm;html;hxx;ini;java;lua;mht;mhtml;odt;pdf;potx;potm;ppam;ppsm;ppsx;pps;ppt;pptm;pptx;rtf;sldm;sldx;thmx;txt;vsd;wpd;wps;wri;xlam;xls;xlsb;xlsm;xlsx;xltm;xltx;xml |
| Executable | ext:bat;cmd;exe;msi;msp;scr |
| Folder | folder: |
| Picture | ext:ani;bmp;gif;ico;jpe;jpeg;jpg;pcx;png;psd;tga;tif;tiff;webp;wmf |
| Video | ext:3g2;3gp;...;wmv (full list at 0x1401bd540) |
Macros audio:, zip:, doc:, exe:, pic:, video: use the same lists (help text 0x1401c81e0).

## Search syntax (help text 0x1401c81e0, parser sub_140116168 / sub_140114300)
- space = AND, `|` = OR, `!` = NOT, `< >` = grouping, `"..."` = exact phrase.
- `*` zero or more characters, `?` one character; a wildcard term matches the whole file name.
- Modifiers: case:, diacritics:, file:, folder:, path:, regex:, wholeword:/ww:, wfn:/wholefilename:, startwith:, endwith:; `no` prefix disables (nocase:, nopath:, nowholeword:, noregex:).
- A term containing `\` is matched against the full path (estimated rule, from the "path:" behaviour).
- Functions implemented: ext:a;b, size:, dm:/datemodified:, dc:/datecreated:, infolder:, parent:, len:, count:, dupe:, empty:, attrib:.
- Not implemented (need content or media metadata): content:, album:, artist:, dimensions:, etc.

## size: (sub_140055200, thresholds at 0x1401fed10)
| Keyword | Range (bytes) |
|---|---|
| empty | 0 |
| tiny | 1 – 10,240 |
| small | 10,241 – 102,400 |
| medium | 102,401 – 1,048,576 |
| large | 1,048,577 – 16,777,216 |
| huge | 16,777,217 – 134,217,728 |
| gigantic | > 134,217,728 |
| unknown | size not known |
Units: kb=1024, mb=1024², gb=1024³, tb=1024⁴, pb, eb. A number with a unit matches a 1 KB-wide band ending at the value rounded up to 1024 (lo = hi − 1023). `a..b` or `a-b` are ranges; `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `=` comparisons.

## dates (sub_14005eeb0, strings 0x1401ba378..0x1401ba4dc)
today, yesterday, tomorrow; this/last/past/next + week/month/year; lastNdays / pastNweeks / lastNmonths / lastNyears / lastNhours / lastNminutes; explicit yyyy, yyyy-mm, yyyy-mm-dd or d/m/yyyy; comparisons and `..` ranges.

## Export
File list export header "Filename,Size,Date Modified,Date Created,Attributes" with sizes and FILETIME dates as integers and attributes as a number (0x1400f6f20). CSV of the visible results.

## Indexing
The original reads the NTFS master file table and USN journal. This rebuild walks every fixed drive with parallel directory reads, saves the index to disk, loads it at the next start and refreshes it in the background. Live updates use the folder change watcher. Reparse points (junctions/links) are listed but not followed.

content.text:
I built **Quickfind**, a file-name search tool modelled on the original. It indexes every drive on this computer: it found about 3.2 million files and folders, and after the first scan it opens with everything listed in about one and a half seconds. Typing searches as you go, with most searches taking under a tenth of a second. It keeps up with files you add, rename or delete while it's open.

**What matches the original:**
- **Search language:** it uses the same rules I read out of the original's code. That covers AND, OR (`|`), NOT (`!`) and `< >` grouping, wildcards, `case:`, `path:`, `ext:`, `size:` (with the original's tiny, small and huge size bands), dates like `dm:today`, and `dupe:`.
- **Filters:** Audio, Document, Picture and the rest use the original's exact file-type lists.
- **Window:** same menus, Name / Path / Size / Date Modified columns, a small arrow on the sorted column, and the "N objects" status bar.
- **Other features:** bookmarks, exporting results to a file, and the original's start-up options for searching, filtering and sorting.

**What differs or is still unknown:**
- **Columns:** the Name and Path columns are a bit narrower than the original's, so Size and Date fit in the window without scrolling sideways.
- **Size format:** sizes show as KB rounded up, which is a guess. The original never finished loading its own file list while I watched it, so I couldn't see its Size column.
- **How it reads the drives:** the original reads the disk's file table directly, which is faster but usually needs administrator rights. Mine does a normal folder scan each time it starts instead.
- **Not included:** searching inside file contents, music and photo details, and the original's network-sharing servers.
- **Memory:** it uses about 400–480 MB of memory, which is more than the original.

To make it build, I installed a second, self-contained version of Rust's build tools, because this computer has no Microsoft C++ tools. I also had to hold a few libraries at older versions. The automatic check passed the build and the screenshot. It can't yet measure whether the app really behaves by the rules sheet.

A good next request would be an Options window: remembering your column choices, hiding system or hidden files, and leaving out folders you never want searched.

- **Look:** a rounded search bar, filter pills (All, Folders, Documents, Pictures, Audio, Video, Archives, Apps), and a highlight on the part of each name you typed.
- **Tools:** a preview pane for pictures, text and file details, a fuller right-click menu (rename, delete to the Recycle Bin, open with, properties), and an Options window. The Options window covers drives, excluded folders, hidden and system files, columns and row density, and your choices are remembered.

I couldn't test the preview of a selected file, rename, delete or Properties, because the screenshot test doesn't click anything. Only the empty preview pane, the dark theme and the match highlighting were checked.

Q: what are other suggection yours?
A: Here are my other suggestions, roughly from most to least useful.

**Everyday use**
- **Global hotkey and tray icon.** Press one key combination to pop the window up from anywhere, and have it live quietly in the system tray.
- **Search history and suggestions.** A dropdown of recent searches as you type, plus pinned favourites next to the bookmarks.
- **Drag and drop.** Drag results into email, chat or Explorer, and drop a folder on the window to search inside it.
- **Multi-select actions.** Copy, move, zip or batch-rename several results at once.
- **Saved searches as tabs.** Keep several searches open side by side, like browser tabs.

**Smarter searching**
- **Search inside file contents.** Find text within documents and code, not just names.
- **Duplicate finder.** Find files with the same name and size, then review and delete the extras.
- **Folder sizes and a "biggest files" view.** Quickly see what's eating your disk.
- **Recent changes.** A "changed today" list that updates live.
- **Everything-style natural filters.** Clickable chips for size ranges and date ranges, so you don't need to remember `size:>10mb` or `dm:thisweek`.

**Speed and reliability**
- **Faster indexing.** Read the disk's file table directly, as the original does. It makes first start much faster, but needs administrator rights.
- **Lower memory use.** Today the app uses about 400–480 MB for 3 million files, and this could be reduced.

- **Drag and drop:** dropping a folder or file on the window searches for it.

- search inside file contents
- search tabs
- batch rename and zip
- dragging results out into other apps
- reading the disk's file table directly
- lower memory use
- network and USB drive indexing

I'd suggest picking one of those next. Content search is the biggest gain.

186	      <DockPanel>

189	                   VerticalAlignment="Center" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
190	        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
191	          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center"
192	                      Visibility="{Binding IsIndexing, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">

255	          <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
256	            <StackPanel>
257	              <TextBlock Text="Locations" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
258	                         FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
259	                         Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" Margin="10,0,0,6"/>
260	              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Locations}">

<Window x:Class="OmniFind.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns:shell="clr-namespace:System.Windows.Shell;assembly=PresentationFramework"
        xmlns:views="clr-namespace:OmniFind.Views"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="{Binding WindowTitle}"
        Height="820" Width="1280"
        MinHeight="480" MinWidth="900"
        Background="{DynamicResource BgBrush}"
        FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
        FontSize="14"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        AllowDrop="True"
        Drop="Window_Drop"
        DragEnter="Window_DragEnter"
        DragLeave="Window_DragLeave"
        DragOver="Window_DragOver"
        StateChanged="Window_StateChanged"
        PreviewKeyDown="Window_PreviewKeyDown"
        Closing="Window_Closing">
  <shell:WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
    <shell:WindowChrome CaptionHeight="44"
                        ResizeBorderThickness="6"
                        GlassFrameThickness="0"
                        CornerRadius="0"
                        UseAeroCaptionButtons="False"/>
  </shell:WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
  <Window.Resources>
    <BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolVis"/>
    <views:InverseBoolToVisibilityConverter x:Key="InvBoolVis"/>
    <views:GreaterThanOneToVisibilityConverter x:Key="GtOneVis"/>
    <views:ProgressWidthConverter x:Key="ProgWidth"/>
    <ContextMenu x:Key="IndexSettingsMenu">
      <MenuItem Header="Rebuild index" Command="{Binding RebuildCommand}"/>
      <Separator/>
      <MenuItem Header="Exclude system junk (Temp, Recycle Bin, ~$…)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ExcludeSystemJunk}"/>
      <MenuItem Header="Prefer NTFS file-table index" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding PreferNtfs}"/>
      <MenuItem Header="Index USB / removable drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexRemovable}"/>
      <MenuItem Header="Index network drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexNetwork}"/>
    </ContextMenu>
  </Window.Resources>

  <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
          Background="{DynamicResource BgBrush}">
  <Grid>
  <DockPanel>
    <!-- Custom title bar: brand + menus | theme + min/max/close -->
    <Border x:Name="TitleBar"
            DockPanel.Dock="Top"
            Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
            Height="44"
            MouseLeftButtonDown="TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown">
      <DockPanel>
        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Stretch">
          <Button Style="{DynamicResource ThemeToggleButton}"
                  Command="{Binding ToggleThemeCommand}"
                  ToolTip="{Binding ThemeTooltip}"
                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ThemeGlyph}"
                       FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets"
                       FontSize="14"
                       Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
          </Button>
          <Button Style="{DynamicResource CaptionButton}" Content=""
                  ToolTip="Minimize" Click="Minimize_Click"
                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
          <Button x:Name="MaxRestoreButton" Style="{DynamicResource CaptionButton}" Content=""
                  ToolTip="Maximize" Click="Maximize_Click"
                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
          <Button Style="{DynamicResource CaptionCloseButton}" Content=""
                  ToolTip="Close" Click="Close_Click"
                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,0,0">
          <Border Width="24" Height="24" CornerRadius="7" Background="{DynamicResource AccentFillBrush}"
                  Margin="0,0,9,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
            <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="12"
                       Foreground="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}"
                       HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </Border>
          <TextBlock Text="OmniFind" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                     Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"
                     VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,14,0"/>
          <Menu VerticalAlignment="Center"
                shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
            <MenuItem Header="_File">
              <MenuItem Header="Export…" Command="{Binding ExportCommand}"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Exit" Command="{Binding ExitCommand}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_Edit">
              <MenuItem Header="Copy full path" InputGestureText="Ctrl+C" Command="{Binding CopyFullNameCommand}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Select all" InputGestureText="Ctrl+A" Command="{Binding SelectAllCommand}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_View">
              <MenuItem Header="Preview pane" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ShowPreview}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Dark theme" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IsDark}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Command palette" InputGestureText="Ctrl+K" Command="{Binding TogglePaletteCommand}"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Quick views">
                <MenuItem Header="Biggest files" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="biggest-files"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Biggest folders" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="biggest-folders"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Duplicate names" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="dupes"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Empty folders" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="empty"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Changed today" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="today"/>
              </MenuItem>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Accent">
                <MenuItem Header="Blue" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="blue"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Slate" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="slate"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Violet" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="violet"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Orange" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="orange"/>
                <MenuItem Header="Teal" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="teal"/>
              </MenuItem>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Path" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Path}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Size" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Size}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Extension" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Extension}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Date modified" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Modified}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Date created" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Created}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Attributes" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Attributes}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Status bar" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding StatusBarVisible}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_Search">
              <MenuItem Header="Match case" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptCase}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+I"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Match whole words" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptWholeWord}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+B"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Match path" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptPath}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+U"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Match diacritics" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptDiacritics}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+M"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Enable regex" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptRegex}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+R"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Search file contents" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ContentSearchEnabled}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="New tab" Command="{Binding NewTabCommand}"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Everything" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="0"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Audio" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="1"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Compressed" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="2"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Document" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="3"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Executable" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="4"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Folder" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="5"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Picture" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="6"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Video" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="7"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_Bookmarks" Name="BookmarksMenu" SubmenuOpened="BookmarksMenu_Opened">
              <MenuItem Header="Add to bookmarks" InputGestureText="Ctrl+D" Command="{Binding AddBookmarkCommand}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Remove this bookmark" Command="{Binding RemoveBookmarkCommand}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_History" Name="HistoryMenu" SubmenuOpened="HistoryMenu_Opened">
              <MenuItem Header="Clear history" Command="{Binding ClearHistoryCommand}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_Tools">
              <MenuItem Header="Rebuild index" Command="{Binding RebuildCommand}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Run as administrator…" Command="{Binding RunAsAdminCommand}"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Exclude system junk (Temp, Recycle Bin, ~$…)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ExcludeSystemJunk}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Prefer NTFS file-table index" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding PreferNtfs}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Index USB / removable drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexRemovable}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Index network drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexNetwork}"/>
              <Separator/>
              <MenuItem Header="Start with Windows" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding StartWithWindows}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Close to tray" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding CloseToTray}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="Global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding HotkeyEnabled}"/>
            </MenuItem>
            <MenuItem Header="_Help">
              <MenuItem Header="Search syntax" Command="{Binding OpenHelpCommand}"/>
              <MenuItem Header="About OmniFind" Command="{Binding OpenAboutCommand}"/>
            </MenuItem>
          </Menu>
        </StackPanel>
      </DockPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Status bar -->
    <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom"
            Visibility="{Binding StatusBarVisible, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}"
            Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0"
            Height="34" Padding="20,0">
      <DockPanel>
        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left" Text="{Binding StatusLeft}"
                   Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
                   VerticalAlignment="Center" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                      Visibility="{Binding IsIndexing, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
            <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,10,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                     Fill="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}">
              <Ellipse.Style>
                <Style TargetType="Ellipse">
                  <Style.Triggers>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsIndexing}" Value="True">
                      <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard>
                          <Storyboard RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                             From="1" To="0.35" Duration="0:0:1.1" AutoReverse="True"/>
                          </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                      </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    </DataTrigger>
                  </Style.Triggers>
                </Style>
              </Ellipse.Style>
            </Ellipse>
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding IndexPathLabel}" Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                       FontSize="12.5" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
            <Border Width="84" Height="5" CornerRadius="3" Background="{DynamicResource LineBrush}"
                    VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" ClipToBounds="True">
              <Border HorizontalAlignment="Left" Height="5" CornerRadius="3"
                      Background="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"
                      Width="{Binding IndexProgressFraction, Converter={StaticResource ProgWidth}, ConverterParameter=84}"/>
            </Border>
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding IndexFoundLabel}" FontWeight="Medium"
                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </StackPanel>
          <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusRight}"
                     Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
                     VerticalAlignment="Center"
                     Visibility="{Binding IsIndexing, Converter={StaticResource InvBoolVis}}"/>
        </StackPanel>
      </DockPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Body: sidebar + main (tabs / search / category+density / results | inspector) -->
    <Grid>
      <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
        <ColumnDefinition Width="236" MinWidth="200"/>
        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
      </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

      <!-- Left sidebar -->
      <Border Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource SidebarBrush}">
        <DockPanel Margin="12,14,12,12">
          <Button DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Style="{DynamicResource SidebarLink}"
                  HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Margin="0,10,0,0"
                  Click="IndexSettings_Click" ToolTip="Index settings"
                  ContextMenu="{StaticResource IndexSettingsMenu}">
            <DockPanel>
              <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="14" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                         Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
              <TextBlock Text="Index settings" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                         Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
            </DockPanel>
          </Button>

          <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
            <StackPanel>
              <TextBlock Text="Locations" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                         FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                         Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" Margin="10,0,0,6"/>
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Locations}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate>
                    <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource NavRow}"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding DataContext.SelectLocationCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                                  CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                      <DockPanel>
                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left" Text="{Binding Glyph}" Width="18"
                                   Margin="0,0,8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12"
                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right" Text="{Binding CountText}"
                                   FontSize="12" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   FontFamily="{DynamicResource MonoFont}"
                                   Opacity="0.8"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
                      </DockPanel>
                    </ToggleButton>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>

              <TextBlock Text="Saved searches" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                         FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                         Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" Margin="10,18,0,6"/>
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Bookmarks}"
                            Visibility="{Binding HasBookmarks, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate>
                    <Button Style="{DynamicResource SidebarLink}"
                            Command="{Binding DataContext.ApplyBookmarkCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                      <DockPanel>
                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left" Text="☆" Width="18" Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="13"
                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
                      </DockPanel>
                    </Button>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
              <TextBlock Text="Bookmark a search with the star in the search bar."
                         Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="11.5"
                         Margin="10,2,8,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" Opacity="0.85"
                         Visibility="{Binding HasBookmarks, Converter={StaticResource InvBoolVis}}"/>
            </StackPanel>
          </ScrollViewer>
        </DockPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Main column -->
      <DockPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,16,20,16">

        <!-- 1) Tabs row: tabs + '+' on the left, Inspector toggle on the right -->
        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,12" LastChildFill="True">
          <ToggleButton DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                        Style="{DynamicResource InspectorToggle}"
                        ToolTip="Show or hide inspector"
                        IsChecked="{Binding ShowPreview}"
                        Margin="12,0,0,0"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          <ScrollViewer HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Tabs}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                  <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                  </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate>
                    <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource TabPill}"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding DataContext.SelectTabCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                                  CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                      <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Button Content="×" Padding="4,0" Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0"
                                FontSize="14"
                                Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"
                                Command="{Binding DataContext.CloseTabCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                                CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Tabs.Count, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource GtOneVis}}"/>
                      </StackPanel>
                    </ToggleButton>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
              <Button Style="{DynamicResource IconButton}" Content="+" FontSize="16"
                      ToolTip="New tab" Command="{Binding NewTabCommand}" Margin="4,0,0,0"
                      VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
            </StackPanel>
          </ScrollViewer>
        </DockPanel>

        <!-- Search card: always reserve 4px outer ring (transparent idle, accent-soft when focused) so layout never shifts -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" x:Name="SearchHostOuter"
                Background="Transparent"
                BorderBrush="Transparent"
                BorderThickness="4"
                CornerRadius="20"
                Margin="0,0,0,8"
                Padding="0"
                Effect="{DynamicResource SearchCardShadow}"
                IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged="SearchHost_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged">
          <Border x:Name="SearchHost" Style="{DynamicResource SearchCard}">
            <Grid x:Name="SearchHostContent" SizeChanged="SearchHost_SizeChanged">
            <DockPanel>
              <!-- .refine -->
              <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom"
                      Background="{DynamicResource Panel2Brush}"
                      BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Line2Brush}"
                      BorderThickness="0,1,0,0"
                      CornerRadius="0,0,15,15"
                      Padding="20,10">
                <DockPanel>
                  <Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                          Style="{DynamicResource LinkButton}"
                          Content="Clear filters"
                          Command="{Binding ClearRefineCommand}"
                          VerticalAlignment="Center"
                          Visibility="{Binding HasRefineFilters, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}"/>
                  <ScrollViewer HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                                VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                      <TextBlock Text="Size" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                 FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                                 Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,2,0"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="> 10 MB" ToolTip="size:>10mb"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding SizeChip10}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="> 100 MB" ToolTip="size:>100mb"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding SizeChip100}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="> 1 GB" ToolTip="size:>1gb"

1	<Window x:Class="OmniFind.MainWindow"
2	        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
3	        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
4	        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
5	        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
6	        xmlns:shell="clr-namespace:System.Windows.Shell;assembly=PresentationFramework"
7	        xmlns:views="clr-namespace:OmniFind.Views"
8	        mc:Ignorable="d"
9	        Title="{Binding WindowTitle}"
10	        Height="820" Width="1280"
11	        MinHeight="480" MinWidth="900"
12	        Background="{DynamicResource BgBrush}"
13	        FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
14	        FontSize="14"
15	        WindowStyle="None"
16	        ResizeMode="CanResize"
17	        AllowDrop="True"
18	        Drop="Window_Drop"
19	        DragEnter="Window_DragEnter"
20	        DragLeave="Window_DragLeave"
21	        DragOver="Window_DragOver"
22	        StateChanged="Window_StateChanged"
23	        PreviewKeyDown="Window_PreviewKeyDown"

25	  <shell:WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
26	    <shell:WindowChrome CaptionHeight="44"
27	                        ResizeBorderThickness="6"
28	                        GlassFrameThickness="0"
29	                        CornerRadius="0"
30	                        UseAeroCaptionButtons="False"/>
31	  </shell:WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
32	  <Window.Resources>
33	    <BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolVis"/>
34	    <views:InverseBoolToVisibilityConverter x:Key="InvBoolVis"/>
35	    <views:GreaterThanOneToVisibilityConverter x:Key="GtOneVis"/>
36	    <views:ProgressWidthConverter x:Key="ProgWidth"/>
37	    <ContextMenu x:Key="IndexSettingsMenu">
38	      <MenuItem Header="Rebuild index" Command="{Binding RebuildCommand}"/>
39	      <Separator/>
40	      <MenuItem Header="Exclude system junk (Temp, Recycle Bin, ~$…)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ExcludeSystemJunk}"/>
41	      <MenuItem Header="Prefer NTFS file-table index" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding PreferNtfs}"/>
42	      <MenuItem Header="Index USB / removable drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexRemovable}"/>
43	      <MenuItem Header="Index network drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexNetwork}"/>
44	    </ContextMenu>
45	  </Window.Resources>
46	
47	  <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
48	          Background="{DynamicResource BgBrush}">
49	  <Grid>
50	  <DockPanel>
51	    <!-- Custom title bar: brand + menus | theme + min/max/close -->
52	    <Border x:Name="TitleBar"
53	            DockPanel.Dock="Top"
54	            Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
55	            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
56	            Height="44"
57	            MouseLeftButtonDown="TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown">
58	      <DockPanel>
59	        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Stretch">
60	          <Button Style="{DynamicResource ThemeToggleButton}"
61	                  Command="{Binding ToggleThemeCommand}"
62	                  ToolTip="{Binding ThemeTooltip}"
63	                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
64	            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ThemeGlyph}"
65	                       FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets"
66	                       FontSize="14"
67	                       Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
68	          </Button>
69	          <Button Style="{DynamicResource CaptionButton}" Content=""
70	                  ToolTip="Minimize" Click="Minimize_Click"
71	                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
72	          <Button x:Name="MaxRestoreButton" Style="{DynamicResource CaptionButton}" Content=""
73	                  ToolTip="Maximize" Click="Maximize_Click"
74	                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
75	          <Button Style="{DynamicResource CaptionCloseButton}" Content=""
76	                  ToolTip="Close" Click="Close_Click"
77	                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True"/>
78	        </StackPanel>
79	
80	        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,0,0">
81	          <Border Width="24" Height="24" CornerRadius="7" Background="{DynamicResource AccentFillBrush}"
82	                  Margin="0,0,9,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
83	                  shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
84	            <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="12"
85	                       Foreground="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}"
86	                       HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
87	          </Border>
88	          <TextBlock Text="OmniFind" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
89	                     Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"
90	                     VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,14,0"/>
91	          <Menu VerticalAlignment="Center"
92	                shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
93	            <MenuItem Header="_File">
94	              <MenuItem Header="Export…" Command="{Binding ExportCommand}"/>
95	              <Separator/>
96	              <MenuItem Header="Exit" Command="{Binding ExitCommand}"/>
97	            </MenuItem>
98	            <MenuItem Header="_Edit">
99	              <MenuItem Header="Copy full path" InputGestureText="Ctrl+C" Command="{Binding CopyFullNameCommand}"/>
100	              <MenuItem Header="Select all" InputGestureText="Ctrl+A" Command="{Binding SelectAllCommand}"/>
101	            </MenuItem>
102	            <MenuItem Header="_View">
103	              <MenuItem Header="Preview pane" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ShowPreview}"/>
104	              <MenuItem Header="Dark theme" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IsDark}"/>
105	              <MenuItem Header="Command palette" InputGestureText="Ctrl+K" Command="{Binding TogglePaletteCommand}"/>
106	              <Separator/>
107	              <MenuItem Header="Quick views">
108	                <MenuItem Header="Biggest files" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="biggest-files"/>
109	                <MenuItem Header="Biggest folders" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="biggest-folders"/>
110	                <MenuItem Header="Duplicate names" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="dupes"/>
111	                <MenuItem Header="Empty folders" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="empty"/>
112	                <MenuItem Header="Changed today" Command="{Binding QuickViewCommand}" CommandParameter="today"/>
113	              </MenuItem>
114	              <Separator/>
115	              <MenuItem Header="Accent">
116	                <MenuItem Header="Blue" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="blue"/>
117	                <MenuItem Header="Slate" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="slate"/>
118	                <MenuItem Header="Violet" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="violet"/>
119	                <MenuItem Header="Orange" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="orange"/>
120	                <MenuItem Header="Teal" Click="Accent_Click" Tag="teal"/>
121	              </MenuItem>
122	              <Separator/>
123	              <MenuItem Header="Path" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Path}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
124	              <MenuItem Header="Size" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Size}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
125	              <MenuItem Header="Extension" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Extension}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
126	              <MenuItem Header="Date modified" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Modified}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
127	              <MenuItem Header="Date created" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Created}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
128	              <MenuItem Header="Attributes" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding Columns.Attributes}" Click="ColumnMenu_Click"/>
129	              <Separator/>
130	              <MenuItem Header="Status bar" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding StatusBarVisible}"/>
131	            </MenuItem>
132	            <MenuItem Header="_Search">
133	              <MenuItem Header="Match case" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptCase}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+I"/>
134	              <MenuItem Header="Match whole words" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptWholeWord}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+B"/>
135	              <MenuItem Header="Match path" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptPath}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+U"/>
136	              <MenuItem Header="Match diacritics" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptDiacritics}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+M"/>
137	              <Separator/>
138	              <MenuItem Header="Enable regex" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding OptRegex}" InputGestureText="Ctrl+R"/>
139	              <MenuItem Header="Search file contents" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ContentSearchEnabled}"/>
140	              <MenuItem Header="New tab" Command="{Binding NewTabCommand}"/>
141	              <Separator/>
142	              <MenuItem Header="Everything" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="0"/>
143	              <MenuItem Header="Audio" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="1"/>
144	              <MenuItem Header="Compressed" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="2"/>
145	              <MenuItem Header="Document" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="3"/>
146	              <MenuItem Header="Executable" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="4"/>
147	              <MenuItem Header="Folder" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="5"/>
148	              <MenuItem Header="Picture" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="6"/>
149	              <MenuItem Header="Video" Click="FilterMenu_Click" Tag="7"/>
150	            </MenuItem>
151	            <MenuItem Header="_Bookmarks" Name="BookmarksMenu" SubmenuOpened="BookmarksMenu_Opened">
152	              <MenuItem Header="Add to bookmarks" InputGestureText="Ctrl+D" Command="{Binding AddBookmarkCommand}"/>
153	              <MenuItem Header="Remove this bookmark" Command="{Binding RemoveBookmarkCommand}"/>
154	            </MenuItem>
155	            <MenuItem Header="_History" Name="HistoryMenu" SubmenuOpened="HistoryMenu_Opened">
156	              <MenuItem Header="Clear history" Command="{Binding ClearHistoryCommand}"/>
157	            </MenuItem>
158	            <MenuItem Header="_Tools">
159	              <MenuItem Header="Rebuild index" Command="{Binding RebuildCommand}"/>
160	              <MenuItem Header="Run as administrator…" Command="{Binding RunAsAdminCommand}"/>
161	              <Separator/>
162	              <MenuItem Header="Exclude system junk (Temp, Recycle Bin, ~$…)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding ExcludeSystemJunk}"/>
163	              <MenuItem Header="Prefer NTFS file-table index" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding PreferNtfs}"/>
164	              <MenuItem Header="Index USB / removable drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexRemovable}"/>
165	              <MenuItem Header="Index network drives" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding IndexNetwork}"/>
166	              <Separator/>
167	              <MenuItem Header="Start with Windows" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding StartWithWindows}"/>
168	              <MenuItem Header="Close to tray" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding CloseToTray}"/>
169	              <MenuItem Header="Global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space)" IsCheckable="True" IsChecked="{Binding HotkeyEnabled}"/>
170	            </MenuItem>
171	            <MenuItem Header="_Help">
172	              <MenuItem Header="Search syntax" Command="{Binding OpenHelpCommand}"/>
173	              <MenuItem Header="About OmniFind" Command="{Binding OpenAboutCommand}"/>
174	            </MenuItem>
175	          </Menu>
176	        </StackPanel>
177	      </DockPanel>
178	    </Border>

180	    <!-- Status bar -->
181	    <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom"
182	            Visibility="{Binding StatusBarVisible, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}"
183	            Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
184	            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0"
185	            Height="34" Padding="20,0">
186	      <DockPanel>
187	        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left" Text="{Binding StatusLeft}"
188	                   Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
189	                   VerticalAlignment="Center" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
190	        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
191	          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center"
192	                      Visibility="{Binding IsIndexing, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
193	            <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,10,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
194	                     Fill="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}">
195	              <Ellipse.Style>
196	                <Style TargetType="Ellipse">
197	                  <Style.Triggers>
198	                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsIndexing}" Value="True">
199	                      <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
200	                        <BeginStoryboard>
201	                          <Storyboard RepeatBehavior="Forever">
202	                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
203	                                             From="1" To="0.35" Duration="0:0:1.1" AutoReverse="True"/>
204	                          </Storyboard>
205	                        </BeginStoryboard>
206	                      </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
207	                    </DataTrigger>
208	                  </Style.Triggers>
209	                </Style>
210	              </Ellipse.Style>
211	            </Ellipse>
212	            <TextBlock Text="{Binding IndexPathLabel}" Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
213	                       FontSize="12.5" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
214	            <Border Width="84" Height="5" CornerRadius="3" Background="{DynamicResource LineBrush}"
215	                    VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" ClipToBounds="True">
216	              <Border HorizontalAlignment="Left" Height="5" CornerRadius="3"
217	                      Background="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"
218	                      Width="{Binding IndexProgressFraction, Converter={StaticResource ProgWidth}, ConverterParameter=84}"/>
219	            </Border>
220	            <TextBlock Text="{Binding IndexFoundLabel}" FontWeight="Medium"
221	                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
222	                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
223	          </StackPanel>
224	          <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusRight}"
225	                     Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5"
226	                     VerticalAlignment="Center"
227	                     Visibility="{Binding IsIndexing, Converter={StaticResource InvBoolVis}}"/>
228	        </StackPanel>
229	      </DockPanel>
230	    </Border>
231	
232	    <!-- Body: sidebar + main (tabs / search / category+density / results | inspector) -->
233	    <Grid>
234	      <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
235	        <ColumnDefinition Width="236" MinWidth="200"/>
236	        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
237	      </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
238	
239	      <!-- Left sidebar -->
240	      <Border Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource SidebarBrush}">
241	        <DockPanel Margin="12,14,12,12">
242	          <Button DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Style="{DynamicResource SidebarLink}"
243	                  HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Margin="0,10,0,0"
244	                  Click="IndexSettings_Click" ToolTip="Index settings"
245	                  ContextMenu="{StaticResource IndexSettingsMenu}">
246	            <DockPanel>
247	              <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="14" Margin="0,0,10,0"
248	                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
249	                         Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
250	              <TextBlock Text="Index settings" VerticalAlignment="Center"
251	                         Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}"/>
252	            </DockPanel>
253	          </Button>
254	
255	          <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
256	            <StackPanel>
257	              <TextBlock Text="Locations" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
258	                         FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
259	                         Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" Margin="10,0,0,6"/>
260	              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Locations}">
261	                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
262	                  <DataTemplate>
263	                    <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource NavRow}"
264	                                  IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
265	                                  Command="{Binding DataContext.SelectLocationCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
266	                                  CommandParameter="{Binding}">
267	                      <DockPanel>
268	                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left" Text="{Binding Glyph}" Width="18"
269	                                   Margin="0,0,8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12"
270	                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
271	                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right" Text="{Binding CountText}"
272	                                   FontSize="12" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
273	                                   FontFamily="{DynamicResource MonoFont}"
274	                                   Opacity="0.8"
275	                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
276	                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
277	                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
278	                                   Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
279	                      </DockPanel>
280	                    </ToggleButton>
281	                  </DataTemplate>
282	                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
283	              </ItemsControl>
284	
285	              <TextBlock Text="Saved searches" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
