<ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="> 1 GB" ToolTip="size:>1gb"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding SizeChip1g}" Margin="0"/>
                      <Border Width="1" Height="20" Background="{DynamicResource LineBrush}"
                              Margin="8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                      <TextBlock Text="Modified" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                 FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                                 Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,2,0"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="Today" ToolTip="dm:today"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding DateChipToday}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="This week" ToolTip="dm:thisweek"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding DateChipWeek}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource ChipToggle}" Content="This month" ToolTip="dm:thismonth"
                                    IsChecked="{Binding DateChipMonth}" Margin="0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                  </ScrollViewer>
                </DockPanel>
              </Border>

              <!-- .search-row — padding: 6px 10px 6px 20px; min-height:60px; input border:0 -->
              <Grid MinHeight="60" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                  <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                  <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                  <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets"
                           FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"
                           Margin="20,6,10,6"/>
                <Grid Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,6,10,6" MinHeight="44" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                  <TextBlock Text="Search files and folders"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                             FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                             FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                             IsHitTestVisible="False"
                             Visibility="{Binding HasQuery, Converter={StaticResource InvBoolVis}}"/>
                  <TextBox x:Name="SearchBox"
                           Text="{Binding Query, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                           Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0"
                           FontSize="18" Padding="0" Height="44"
                           FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"
                           CaretBrush="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"
                           VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                           GotKeyboardFocus="SearchBox_GotKeyboardFocus"/>
                </Grid>
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,6,10,6">
                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource IconButton}" Content="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="12"
                          ToolTip="Clear search"
                          Focusable="False"
                          Command="{Binding ClearQueryCommand}"
                          Visibility="{Binding HasQuery, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}"/>
                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource IconButtonMd}" Content="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="14"
                          ToolTip="Bookmark this search (Ctrl+D)"
                          Focusable="False"
                          Command="{Binding AddBookmarkCommand}" Margin="0,0,4,0"/>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding MatchCountLabel}"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                             FontSize="13" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                             FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                             MinWidth="110" TextAlignment="Right"
                             Padding="4,0" Margin="0,0,4,0"/>
                  <!-- .toggle-group -->
                  <Border x:Name="OptionsHost" Style="{DynamicResource ToggleGroupHost}">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource OptionToggle}" Content="Aa"
                                    ToolTip="Match case (Ctrl+I)" IsChecked="{Binding OptCase}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource OptionToggle}" Content="Word"
                                    ToolTip="Whole words (Ctrl+B)" IsChecked="{Binding OptWholeWord}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource OptionToggle}" Content="Path"
                                    ToolTip="Match path (Ctrl+U)" IsChecked="{Binding OptPath}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource OptionToggle}" Content="é"
                                    ToolTip="Diacritics (Ctrl+M)" IsChecked="{Binding OptDiacritics}"/>
                      <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource OptionToggle}" Content=".*"
                                    ToolTip="Regex (Ctrl+R)" IsChecked="{Binding OptRegex}" Margin="0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                  </Border>
                </StackPanel>
              </Grid>
            </DockPanel>
            </Grid>
          </Border>
        </Border>

        <!-- 3) Category pills + Density segmented -->
        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,12" LastChildFill="True">
          <Border DockPanel.Dock="Right" Style="{DynamicResource SegmentedHost}" Margin="12,0,0,0">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
              <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource DensityToggle}"
                            ToolTip="Comfortable rows"
                            IsChecked="{Binding ComfortableRows, Mode=OneWay}"
                            Command="{Binding SetDensityCommand}" CommandParameter="comfy">
                <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="14"
                           Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
              </ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource DensityToggle}"
                            ToolTip="Compact rows"
                            IsChecked="{Binding CompactRows, Mode=OneWay}"
                            Command="{Binding SetDensityCommand}" CommandParameter="compact">
                <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="14"
                           Foreground="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ToggleButton}}"/>
              </ToggleButton>
            </StackPanel>
          </Border>

          <ScrollViewer HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
            <Border Style="{DynamicResource SegmentedHost}">
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding FilterPills}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                  <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                  </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate>
                    <ToggleButton Style="{DynamicResource FilterPill}"
                                  Content="{Binding Label}"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding DataContext.SetFilterCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                                  CommandParameter="{Binding Index}"/>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
            </Border>
          </ScrollViewer>
        </DockPanel>

        <!-- 4) Results card + Inspector card -->
        <Grid>
          <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
          </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

          <!-- Results card -->
          <Border Grid.Column="0"
                  Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
                  BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                  CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True">
            <Grid>
              <DataGrid x:Name="ResultsGrid"
                        ItemsSource="{Binding Results}"
                        AutoGenerateColumns="False"
                        IsReadOnly="True"
                        CanUserAddRows="False"
                        CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                        CanUserReorderColumns="False"
                        CanUserResizeColumns="True"
                        CanUserResizeRows="False"
                        SelectionMode="Extended"
                        SelectionUnit="FullRow"
                        HeadersVisibility="Column"
                        GridLinesVisibility="None"
                        RowHeight="{Binding ResultsRowHeight}"
                        MinWidth="700"
                        BorderThickness="0"
                        Background="Transparent"
                        RowBackground="Transparent"
                        AlternatingRowBackground="Transparent"
                        HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                        VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                        VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                        VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                        EnableRowVirtualization="True"
                        MouseDoubleClick="ResultsGrid_MouseDoubleClick"
                        PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown="ResultsGrid_PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown"
                        PreviewMouseMove="ResultsGrid_PreviewMouseMove"
                        Sorting="ResultsGrid_Sorting">
                <DataGrid.ContextMenu>
                  <ContextMenu>
                    <MenuItem Header="Open" Click="CtxOpen_Click"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Open path" Click="CtxOpenPath_Click"/>
                    <Separator/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Copy full name" Click="CtxCopyFull_Click"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Copy name" Click="CtxCopyName_Click"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Copy path" Click="CtxCopyPath_Click"/>
                    <Separator/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Copy to…" Command="{Binding CopyToCommand}"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Move to…" Command="{Binding MoveToCommand}"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Zip selected…" Command="{Binding ZipSelectedCommand}"/>
                    <MenuItem Header="Batch rename…" Command="{Binding BatchRenameCommand}"/>
                  </ContextMenu>
                </DataGrid.ContextMenu>
                <DataGrid.Columns>
                  <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Name" Width="1.2*" MinWidth="200" CanUserResize="True" SortMemberPath="Name">
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                      <DataTemplate>
                        <!-- DockPanel LastChildFill gives the name a real width; StackPanel/* Grid still collapsed names -->
                        <DockPanel LastChildFill="True" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   ToolTip="{Binding Name}">
                          <Image DockPanel.Dock="Left" Source="{Binding Icon}" Width="16" Height="16"
                                 Margin="2,0,10,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                 SnapsToDevicePixels="True"
                                 RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="NearestNeighbor"/>
                          <views:HighlightTextBlock
                              SourceText="{Binding Name}"
                              Query="{Binding DataContext.Query, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              MatchCase="{Binding DataContext.OptCase, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              WholeWord="{Binding DataContext.OptWholeWord, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              RegexMode="{Binding DataContext.OptRegex, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              Diacritics="{Binding DataContext.OptDiacritics, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              Enabled="True"
                              VerticalAlignment="Center"
                              HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                              Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"
                              FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                              FontSize="13"
                              TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                              TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        </DockPanel>
                      </DataTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                  </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                  <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Location" Width="1.8*" MinWidth="160" CanUserResize="True" SortMemberPath="Path"
                                          Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Path, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                      <DataTemplate>
                        <views:HighlightTextBlock
                            SourceText="{Binding Path=Path}"
                            Query="{Binding DataContext.Query, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            MatchCase="{Binding DataContext.OptCase, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            WholeWord="{Binding DataContext.OptWholeWord, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            RegexMode="{Binding DataContext.OptRegex, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            Diacritics="{Binding DataContext.OptDiacritics, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            Enabled="{Binding DataContext.OptPath, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                            ToolTip="{Binding Path}"
                            Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                            FontFamily="{DynamicResource MonoFont}"
                            FontSize="12"
                            TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                            TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                      </DataTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                  </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                  <DataGridTextColumn Header="Size" Binding="{Binding Size}" Width="100" MinWidth="88"
                                      CanUserResize="True"
                                      Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Size, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                      <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                        <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Right"/>
                        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,4,0"/>
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{DynamicResource UiFont}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
                        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                        <Setter Property="TextTrimming" Value="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        <Setter Property="ToolTip" Value="{Binding Size}"/>
                      </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                  </DataGridTextColumn>
                  <DataGridTextColumn Header="Ext" Binding="{Binding Extension}" Width="64" MinWidth="56"
                                      Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Extension, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                      <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                      </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                  </DataGridTextColumn>
                  <DataGridTextColumn Header="Modified" Binding="{Binding Modified}" Width="152" MinWidth="140"
                                      Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Modified, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                      <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{DynamicResource UiFont}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
                        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                      </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                  </DataGridTextColumn>
                  <DataGridTextColumn Header="Created" Binding="{Binding Created}" Width="152" MinWidth="140"
                                      Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Created, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                      <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{DynamicResource UiFont}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
                        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                      </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                  </DataGridTextColumn>
                  <DataGridTextColumn Header="Attr" Binding="{Binding Attributes}" Width="64" MinWidth="56"
                                      Visibility="{Binding DataContext.Columns.Attributes, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                      <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                        <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{DynamicResource MonoFont}"/>
                        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                      </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                  </DataGridTextColumn>
                </DataGrid.Columns>
              </DataGrid>

              <!-- Empty-state overlay -->
              <Border Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
                      Visibility="{Binding ShowOverlay, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center" MaxWidth="440">
                  <Border Width="48" Height="48" CornerRadius="14" Margin="0,0,0,16"
                          Background="{DynamicResource AccentSoftBrush}" HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets"
                               FontSize="20"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"/>
                  </Border>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding OverlayTitle}" FontSize="20" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" TextAlignment="Center"/>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding OverlayMessage}" Margin="0,10,0,14" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" TextAlignment="Center" FontSize="13.5"
                             LineHeight="22"/>
                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource ActionButton}"
                          Content="Clear search and filters"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                          HorizontalContentAlignment="Center"
                          Padding="16,9"
                          Command="{Binding ClearSearchAndFiltersCommand}"/>
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>
            </Grid>
          </Border>

          <!-- Inspector card -->
          <Border Grid.Column="1" Width="340" MaxWidth="380" Margin="12,0,0,0"
                  Background="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}"
                  BorderBrush="{DynamicResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                  CornerRadius="16"
                  Visibility="{Binding PreviewPaneVisible, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
            <Grid Margin="18,16">
              <!-- Empty state -->
              <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                          Visibility="{Binding Preview.HasSelection, Converter={StaticResource InvBoolVis}}">
                <TextBlock Text="" FontFamily="Segoe MDL2 Assets" FontSize="28"
                           HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,12"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
                <TextBlock Text="Nothing selected" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"
                           HorizontalAlignment="Center" TextAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Text="Pick a result to see its preview, size, and location."
                           Margin="0,6,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" TextAlignment="Center"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5" LineHeight="20"
                           MaxWidth="240"/>
              </StackPanel>

              <!-- Filled state -->
              <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                            Visibility="{Binding Preview.HasSelection, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                <StackPanel>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Preview.Name}" FontSize="18" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             FontFamily="{DynamicResource UiFont}"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                  <Border Background="{DynamicResource AccentSoftBrush}" CornerRadius="999"
                          Padding="10,3" Margin="0,8,0,12" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Preview.KindLabel}"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentInkBrush}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                  </Border>

                  <Border Background="{DynamicResource RaisedBrush}" CornerRadius="12" Padding="10"
                          Margin="0,0,0,12" Height="170"
                          Visibility="{Binding Preview.ShowImage, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <Image Source="{Binding Preview.Image}" Stretch="Uniform"/>
                  </Border>
                  <Border Background="{DynamicResource RaisedBrush}" CornerRadius="12" Padding="12"
                          Margin="0,0,0,12" MaxHeight="170"
                          Visibility="{Binding Preview.ShowText, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Preview.Text}"
                               FontFamily="{DynamicResource MonoFont}" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                  </Border>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Preview.Note}" Margin="0,0,0,12"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"
                             Visibility="{Binding Preview.ShowNote, Converter={StaticResource BoolVis}}"/>

                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource PrimaryActionButton}" Content="Open"
                          HorizontalContentAlignment="Center"
                          Command="{Binding OpenSelectedCommand}"/>
                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource ActionButton}" Content="Show in folder"
                          HorizontalContentAlignment="Center"
                          Command="{Binding OpenPathCommand}"/>
                  <Button Style="{DynamicResource ActionButton}"
                          Content="{Binding CopyPathLabel}"
                          HorizontalContentAlignment="Center"
                          Command="{Binding CopyPathCommand}" Margin="0,0,0,14"/>

                  <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Preview.Rows}">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                      <DataTemplate>
                        <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Line2Brush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="0,11">
                          <Grid>
                            <Grid>
                              <Grid.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Grid">
                                  <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                  <Style.Triggers>
                                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Label}" Value="Location">
                                      <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    </DataTrigger>
                                  </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                              </Grid.Style>
                              <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="88"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                              </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                              <TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" Foreground="{DynamicResource DimBrush}" FontSize="12.5"/>
                              <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Value}" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                         TextAlignment="Right" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" FontSize="12.5"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <StackPanel>
                              <StackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="StackPanel">
                                  <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                  <Style.Triggers>
                                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Label}" Value="Location">
                                      <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>

    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource TextBrush}"/>

    <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>

    <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
    <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="True"/>
    <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource FocusRing}"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
          <Border x:Name="Bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                  BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                  BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                  CornerRadius="15" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                  SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </Border>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <!-- chip hover: mute border -->
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource DimBrush}"/>
            </Trigger>
            <!-- chip active -->
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentSoftBrush}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"/>
              <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AccentInkBrush}"/>
              <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            </Trigger>
            <MultiTrigger>
              <MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                <Condition Property="IsChecked" Value="True"/>
                <Condition Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"/>
              </MultiTrigger.Conditions>
              <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentSoftBrush}"/>
              <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}"/>
              <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AccentInkBrush}"/>
            </MultiTrigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
              <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/>
            </Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>

## Search syntax (help text 0x1401c81e0, parser sub_140116168 / sub_140114300)
- space = AND, `|` = OR, `!` = NOT, `< >` = grouping, `"..."` = exact phrase.
- `*` zero or more characters, `?` one character; a wildcard term matches the whole file name.
- Modifiers: case:, diacritics:, file:, folder:, path:, regex:, wholeword:/ww:, wfn:/wholefilename:, startwith:, endwith:; `no` prefix disables (nocase:, nopath:, nowholeword:, noregex:).
- A term containing `\` is matched against the full path (estimated rule, from the "path:" behaviour).
- Functions implemented: ext:a;b, size:, dm:/datemodified:, dc:/datecreated:, infolder:, parent:, len:, count:, dupe:, empty:, attrib:.
- Not implemented (need content or media metadata): content:, album:, artist:, dimensions:, etc.

## size: (sub_140055200, thresholds at 0x1401fed10)
| Keyword | Range (bytes) |
|---|---|
| empty | 0 |
| tiny | 1 – 10,240 |
| small | 10,241 – 102,400 |
| medium | 102,401 – 1,048,576 |
| large | 1,048,577 – 16,777,216 |
| huge | 16,777,217 – 134,217,728 |
| gigantic | > 134,217,728 |
| unknown | size not known |
Units: kb=1024, mb=1024², gb=1024³, tb=1024⁴, pb, eb. A number with a unit matches a 1 KB-wide band ending at the value rounded up to 1024 (lo = hi − 1023). `a..b` or `a-b` are ranges; `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `=` comparisons.

## dates (sub_14005eeb0, strings 0x1401ba378..0x1401ba4dc)
today, yesterday, tomorrow; this/last/past/next + week/month/year; lastNdays / pastNweeks / lastNmonths / lastNyears / lastNhours / lastNminutes; explicit yyyy, yyyy-mm, yyyy-mm-dd or d/m/yyyy; comparisons and `..` ranges.

## Export
File list export header "Filename,Size,Date Modified,Date Created,Attributes" with sizes and FILETIME dates as integers and attributes as a number (0x1400f6f20). CSV of the visible results.

## Indexing
The original reads the NTFS master file table and USN journal. This rebuild walks every fixed drive with parallel directory reads, saves the index to disk, loads it at the next start and refreshes it in the background. Live updates use the folder change watcher. Reparse points (junctions/links) are listed but not followed.

# Mechanics sheet — OmniFind (a file-name search tool in the style of the original)

## Window layout (from the OmniFind project: MainWindow.xaml, Themes/Controls.xaml, Dark.xaml, Light.xaml)
Custom 44 px title bar (logo, menus File/Edit/View/Search/Bookmarks/History/Tools/Help, theme, min/max/close); 236 px sidebar
(Locations with item counts, Saved searches, Index settings); main column margins 8/16/20/16: tabs row + Inspector toggle,
search card (radius 16, 60 px input row, Aa/Word/Path/é/.* group, Size and Modified chips), file-type pills + density toggle,
results card (radius 16, header 42, rows 48 comfortable / 34 compact, radius-8 selection band), inspector card 340 px,
34 px status bar. Colours, five accents (Blue, Slate, Violet, Orange, Teal), fonts (Instrument Sans, JetBrains Mono, Segoe MDL2).
Status texts, empty-state titles/messages, size format (B / KB 2-1-0 decimals) and date format dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm follow MainViewModel.cs.
Light theme, no inspector and comfortable rows are the defaults (as in a first start of the original).
